parent_identity.primary_mark: Three ascending parallelograms plus open champagne-gold continuity arc; original vector to be verified, never reverse engineered from brochure

technology_only_accent.scope: Digital systems and technology-focused interfaces only; not parent institutional collateral

mark_rules: Retain the three ascending forms and proportional relationships
Do not close or remove the open arc
Do not imply a tech demo mark is the parent master
Never create a new master mark from generative art or PDF raster
Preserve sub-brand distinctive verified original marks

child_identity.unverified_asset_fallback: Plain typographic Evercraft endorsement until approved source parent master is found

notes: The review preview may use digital accent graphics but must not claim to be the company's approved institutional lockup; external branding uses exact approved source assets only.
